gaps.gap: Annual balance does not establish hourly or seasonal reliability.
gaps.test: Stress-test portfolios with weather-correlated low-renewable events, outages, reserve margins, and storage state of charge.

gaps.gap: Electricity decarbonization is often conflated with complete fossil independence.
gaps.test: Separate combustion, emergency, and non-energy feedstock boundaries in scenario accounting.

gaps.gap: Hard-to-electrify sectors and conversion losses are under-integrated.
gaps.test: Co-model aviation, shipping, steel, chemicals, high-temperature heat, hydrogen, ammonia, and sustainable fuels.

gaps.gap: Technology potential is not the same as deployable capacity.
gaps.test: Include transmission, distribution, permitting, manufacturing, material, workforce, and financing constraints.

gaps.gap: System-wide affordability and access can be hidden by average cost metrics.
gaps.test: Report household and industrial energy-service adequacy, distributional cost, and reliability outcomes.

gaps.gap: Policy and adoption are often exogenous to technical models.
gaps.test: Use phased adoption, infrastructure lead times, risk-sharing, and policy sensitivity analysis.
